entries.en:
“As a nutritional therapist specialized in female hormones, I’m extremely careful about what I put into my body. Hormones are sensitive. Stress, toxins, poor-quality ingredients — they all add up. So I don’t just look at labels, I look at what something will do inside the body.

I choose Karmicare because I trust what’s in it — and what’s not. No unnecessary fillers, no hidden disruptors. Just clean, purposeful ingredients that support rather than burden the nervous system and hormonal balance. When you understand how delicate the female endocrine system can be, especially under chronic stress, quality isn’t optional.

And that’s also why I use it in my practice.

I work with women dealing with PMS, cycle issues, stress-related fatigue, estrogen dominance and adrenal dysregulation. I need products that are technically sound — bioavailable, well-formulated, and supportive of detox pathways and nervous system regulation.

Karmicare fits that standard.”

entries.en: Why two formulas instead of one?
entries.notes: type text

entries.en: Because your mouth doesn’t do the same job all day. Daytime is exposure to acids, sugars and coffee, so Awake protects, activates and brightens. Night is repair, when saliva drops and your body regenerates, so Asleep soothes, supports your mouth’s balance and helps remineralise. Spit, don’t rinse. Left on after the evening brush, it gets extended contact time.

entries.en:
“I have been using Karmicare for a long time and feel strongly drawn to their vision of oral care. Our mouth, too, follows the natural rhythm of our body: the oral environment is different during the day than at night. What’s more, oral health does not stand on its own; it is closely connected to our general health.

As a dentist, I find the formulation interesting because of the combination of, among other things, nano-hydroxyapatite and xylitol in a fluoride-free leave-on formula. Because you don’t need to rinse after brushing, the caring ingredients stay in contact with the teeth and the mouth for longer. The two different formulas also fit nicely within the vision of our natural day-and-night rhythm: fresh and invigorating in the morning (with guarana for morning energy), and warmer and spicier in the evening (with valerian, which contributes to calm and relaxation).

My patients who use Karmicare are very happy with it and find it a pleasant toothpaste. My children, who are critical about flavours, also use Karmicare with pleasure! I find that at least as important: good oral care starts with a toothpaste you enjoy and keep using consistently. Wonderfully fresh, without feeling aggressive in the mouth. I’m a fan!”
entries.notes: type richtext; practitioner quote of Dr. Stephanie Spreuwers (Functional Dentist, kPNI Practitioner), shown on desktop hover; inventoried 24 Oct from live main 85cdb59 (landing desk R71 c)

entries.en:
“As a dental hygienist and quality manager with more than 13 years of experience in oral healthcare, I am critical about which products I recommend. What I particularly value about Karmicare is the combination of an effective and safe formulation that is also pleasant to use.

In my own experience I notice a pleasant taste, a smoother feel on the teeth and teeth that look whiter, and all that without fluoride. It offers an interesting and reliable alternative for both professional and everyday use.

I see Karmicare as a valuable addition to modern oral care and see good potential for use by a broad audience.”

entries.en:
“As a nutritional therapist specialized in female hormones, I’m extremely careful about what I put into my body. Hormones are sensitive. Stress, toxins, poor-quality ingredients — they all add up. So I don’t just look at labels, I look at what something will do inside the body.

I choose Karmicare because I trust what’s in it — and what’s not. No unnecessary fillers, no hidden disruptors. Just clean, purposeful ingredients that support rather than burden the nervous system and hormonal balance. When you understand how delicate the female endocrine system can be, especially under chronic stress, quality isn’t optional.

And that’s also why I use it in my practice.

I work with women dealing with PMS, cycle issues, stress-related fatigue, estrogen dominance and adrenal dysregulation. I need products that are technically sound — bioavailable, well-formulated, and supportive of detox pathways and nervous system regulation.

Karmicare fits that standard.”

entries.en:
“I have been using Karmicare for a long time and feel strongly drawn to their vision of oral care. Our mouth, too, follows the natural rhythm of our body: the oral environment is different during the day than at night. What’s more, oral health does not stand on its own; it is closely connected to our general health.

As a dentist, I find the formulation interesting because of the combination of, among other things, nano-hydroxyapatite and xylitol in a fluoride-free leave-on formula. Because you don’t need to rinse after brushing, the caring ingredients stay in contact with the teeth and the mouth for longer. The two different formulas also fit nicely within the vision of our natural day-and-night rhythm: fresh and invigorating in the morning (with guarana for morning energy), and warmer and spicier in the evening (with valerian, which contributes to calm and relaxation).

My patients who use Karmicare are very happy with it and find it a pleasant toothpaste. My children, who are critical about flavours, also use Karmicare with pleasure! I find that at least as important: good oral care starts with a toothpaste you enjoy and keep using consistently. Wonderfully fresh, without feeling aggressive in the mouth. I’m a fan!”
entries.notes: type richtext; practitioner quote of Dr. Stephanie Spreuwers (Functional Dentist, kPNI Practitioner), shown on desktop hover; inventoried 24 Oct from live main 85cdb59 (landing desk R71 c)

entries.en:
“As a dental hygienist and quality manager with more than 13 years of experience in oral healthcare, I am critical about which products I recommend. What I particularly value about Karmicare is the combination of an effective and safe formulation that is also pleasant to use.

In my own experience I notice a pleasant taste, a smoother feel on the teeth and teeth that look whiter, and all that without fluoride. It offers an interesting and reliable alternative for both professional and everyday use.

I see Karmicare as a valuable addition to modern oral care and see good potential for use by a broad audience.”
entries.notes: type richtext; practitioner quote of Mariama Banjai (Dental Hygienist, Oral Care Quality Manager), shown on desktop hover; inventoried 24 Oct from live main 85cdb59 (landing desk R71 c)

entries.en: 1. Our commitment to trust and transparency
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Your rights come from the law, not from our goodwill. This page sets them out in one place, alongside the promises Karmicare adds on top.

This page explains your rights in plain words. The Terms and Conditions are the contract. If the two ever differ, whichever is more favourable to you applies.

At KARMICARE, we believe in radical transparency, both in the biological formulations we craft and in the commercial relationships we build with our community. This charter summarises your statutory rights under:

  • The Belgian Code of Economic Law (WER/CDE), notably Book VI on market practices and consumer protection;
  • The EU Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU);
  • The EU Omnibus Directive (2019/2161) on modernised consumer protection rules;
  • The EU Sale of Goods Directive (2019/771), transposed into Belgian law by the Law of 20 March 2022;
  • The EU Cosmetics Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009.

Whether you try a single duo or become a member, your legal rights are fully protected.

entries.en:
Awake and Asleep are cosmetic products under EU law. The toothbrushes and the floss are general consumer products.

Awake Morning Toothpaste and Asleep Evening Toothpaste are cosmetic products under Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, notified on the European Cosmetic Product Notification Portal (CPNP). They are cosmetics for daily oral care. They are not medicinal products or medical devices and do not claim to diagnose, treat or cure medical conditions.

The Toothbrushes and the Charcoal Floss are not cosmetics. They are general consumer products covered by Regulation (EU) 2023/988 on general product safety.

entries.old_en:
Awake and Asleep are notified EU cosmetics, made under Good Manufacturing Practice and assessed by a qualified safety assessor.

All KARMICARE products, including Awake Morning Toothpaste, Asleep Evening Toothpaste, Charcoal Floss and the Toothbrushes, are:

  • Formulated and manufactured in accordance with European Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP / ISO 22716);
  • Registered and notified on the European Cosmetic Product Notification Portal (CPNP) in compliance with Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009;
  • Subject to a Cosmetic Product Safety Report (CPSR) signed by a qualified European safety assessor;
  • 100% free of SLS, parabens, artificial dyes, endocrine disruptors and controversial abrasives.

Regulatory classification: KARMICARE oral care products are cosmetics intended for daily oral hygiene, biorhythmic remineralisation and enamel support. They are not medicinal products or medical devices and do not claim to diagnose, treat or cure medical conditions.

entries.en: 3. Refunds, withdrawal and money-back guarantees
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Every first order comes with a money-back guarantee: 14 days on Try Once, your first cycle on the 60-Day rhythm, 60 days on the Year. Your legal right to withdraw comes on top.

3.1 Your legal right to withdraw (14 days)

  • You can withdraw from an online order within 14 calendar days of delivery, without giving a reason (Article VI.47 of the Belgian Code of Economic Law). For a membership, the 14 days run from your first delivery. Tell us through the online withdrawal function (Withdraw from contract here), by email at care@karmicare.com, by phone on +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, or with the form in section 10. You do not need our approval.
  • We reimburse all payments received from you, including standard delivery charges, within 14 calendar days of the day you tell us (Article VI.50 WER). We may wait until we have received the goods back or until you have shown that you sent them, whichever comes first.
  • Send the goods back within 14 days of telling us; for a membership that is everything delivered under it, the Welcome Kit included. You may check them as you would in a shop. If you handled or used them beyond that, for example by priming a pump, we may deduct the resulting loss of value from your refund (Article VI.51 §2 WER); see section 3.7.
  • This right comes from the law. Our money-back guarantees below come on top of it and never limit it.

3.2 Try Once: 14-day money-back guarantee

  • Not convinced? Tell us within 14 days of delivery and we refund everything you paid, including shipping.
  • You may open and try the duo, and keep it. Nothing has to be sent back.

3.3 60-Day rhythm: your first cycle

  • The guarantee covers your first 60-day cycle. Tell us before your first renewal (60 days after your order) and we refund your first payment.
  • Care Credit from that payment that you already used on another order is deducted, unless you return what you bought with it (Terms 4.7.6); unused credit from it lapses.
  • You keep the duo and the Welcome Kit. Your membership ends and nothing renews.
  • We remind you 5 days before your first renewal. Continuing into your second cycle ends the guarantee.

3.4 Year: 60 days from your first delivery

  • Tell us within 60 days of your first delivery and we refund your annual payment, minus any Care Credit from it that you already used on another order, unless you return what you bought with it (Terms 4.7.6). Unused credit from it lapses, and your remaining deliveries are cancelled.
  • You keep the opened duo and the Welcome Kit. Send the other duos back unopened (pump never primed) within 14 days, with the prepaid label we send you.
  • For each extra duo that comes back opened, or does not come back, €59 is deducted. If the return parcel gets lost, you still get your refund once the carrier’s tracking shows it was handed in.

3.5 One money-back guarantee per customer

Each customer has one money-back guarantee, whichever option you start with. Switching to another plan or rejoining later does not add a new one. Your legal rights are never limited by this.

3.6 How refunds work

  1. Email care@karmicare.com, or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, with your order number.
  2. Under your legal right, we refund within 14 days of the day you tell us; we may wait until the goods are back or you have shown that you sent them. Under our money-back guarantees, we refund within 14 days of your request or, for a Year refund, of receiving your returned duos. The money always goes back to the payment method you used; we never replace a refund with a voucher unless you ask for one.
  3. If you paid partly with Care Credit, that credit returns to your balance, and the Care Credit earned on the refunded amount lapses in proportion; nothing is deducted for credit you had not used. If you had already used that credit on articles of another order, we tell you which order, which articles and which amount before you choose. You may return those articles with our prepaid label within 14 days of receiving it: nothing is deducted for them and we refund the money you paid for them. Under your legal rights, keeping them and paying that credit needs your express agreement, given after that information; we never treat silence as agreement and never delay or reduce your legal refund while asking. Under our money-back guarantees (3.3 and 3.4), that credit is deducted if you keep them. Clauses 4.7.4 to 4.7.6 of the Terms have the full rule. Care Credit is never paid out in cash.
  4. To return goods after a legal withdrawal, send them within 14 days of telling us to: KARMICA BV, Returns Department, Vizierstraat 28, 8000 Bruges, Belgium. No return authorisation is needed. Return shipping is yours, unless the item arrived damaged or defective.

3.7 Packaging notice: airless pump and first-use priming

  • Hermetic airless protection. Our formulas are housed in hygienic airless pump dispensers that shield the formulation from air, oxidation and microbial contamination without relying on harsh preservatives.
  • First-use priming (3 to 10 pumps). Our pumps are not pre-pumped. On first use, press the pump head firmly 3 to 10 times to draw the formula into the nozzle.
  • Primed pumps and your legal right: priming a pump and using a formula goes beyond checking it. Your right to withdraw remains, but we may deduct the loss of value this causes from your refund, up to the full price of that formula (Article VI.51 §2 WER). Our money-back guarantees above are more generous and are not affected.

entries.en: Two-year guarantee
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en: 4. Two-year legal guarantee of conformity
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
If something is faulty, you are covered for two years from delivery, and the law assumes the fault was there from the start.

Under Belgian law (Articles 1649bis and following of the Civil Code, implementing Directive (EU) 2019/771), European consumers benefit from a mandatory two-year legal guarantee of conformity on all goods purchased from KARMICARE.

4.1 Two years, presumed from delivery

  • If an item does not conform, for example a faulty pump, a defective formula, a broken brush or goods that do not match our description, you are protected for two years from delivery (Article 1649quater §1 of the Civil Code).
  • Any defect that appears within those two years is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery, unless we prove otherwise or that is incompatible with the nature of the goods or of the defect (Article 1649quater §4). You do not have to prove the cause.

4.2 Your remedies

  1. Free replacement or repair. You choose between a free replacement and a repair, provided the remedy you choose is not impossible or disproportionate.
  2. Price reduction or ending the contract. If repair or replacement is impossible, is refused, is not done within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience, or does not solve the problem, or if the defect is serious enough to justify it at once, you can ask for a proportionate price reduction or end the contract and be refunded. Ending the contract is not possible for a minor defect, and we must prove that a defect is minor (Article 1649quinquies).
  3. Not a defect. Using up a formula, normal bristle wear and use after the Period After Opening are not lacks of conformity. Clause 7 of the Terms has the full rules and examples.

4.3 Telling us about a defect

Let us know within two months of discovering a defect (Article 1649quater, §2 of the Belgian Civil Code). Email care@karmicare.com with photos or a video of the defect and your order details.

If something is faulty, you are covered for two years from delivery, and the law assumes the fault was there from the start.

Under Belgian law (Article 1649bis and following of the Civil Code and Book VI WER, implementing Directive (EU) 2019/771), European consumers benefit from a mandatory two-year legal guarantee of conformity on all goods purchased from KARMICARE.

4.1 Two-year presumption of conformity

  • If a delivered item is defective, non-conforming or damaged on delivery, you are protected for two full years (24 months) from the date of delivery.
  • Any defect that appears within those two years is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery, unless proven otherwise or incompatible with the nature of the goods.

4.2 Your remedies

  1. Free replacement or repair. You choose between a free replacement and a repair, provided the remedy you choose is not impossible or disproportionate.
  2. Price reduction or ending the contract. If replacement is impossible, or cannot be carried out within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience, you can ask for an appropriate price reduction or a full refund and end the contract.

4.3 Telling us about a defect

Let us know within two months of discovering a defect (Article 1649quater, §2 of the Belgian Civil Code). Email care@karmicare.com with photos or a video of the defect and your order details.

Until your parcel is in your hands, it is our responsibility.

  • Where we deliver: to every member state of the European Union.
  • Shipping: memberships ship free. For Try Once, the shipping charge for your zone is shown at checkout before you pay.
  • Risk in transit (Art. VI.44 WER). The risk of loss, damage or theft in transit stays with KARMICARE until the parcel is handed to you or to the recipient you name.
  • Delayed deliveries. Unless we agreed another date, we deliver within 30 days. If we do not, you can give us an additional reasonable period; if we still fail to deliver, you can end the contract and receive a full refund within 14 calendar days.

Delivery times (estimates)

  • Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg: within 24 hours
  • Rest of the European Union: 2–3 working days

entries.en: 6. Your membership: renewals, pauses and cancelling
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
No lock-in. Your member price stays the same, we remind you before every renewal, and you can gift, pause or stop whenever you like.

  • Billing: the 60-Day rhythm renews every 60 days. The Year renews once a year on its anniversary, with your six duos delivered in two parts: three at the start and three after six months.
  • Renewal reminder: we email you 5 days before every 60-Day rhythm renewal, and 30 days and 7 days before every Year renewal, so you have time to pause, reschedule, skip or cancel.
  • Pausing: pause for up to 60 days at a time, and for up to 60 days in total within any 12 months. On the Year, you can postpone your second delivery by up to 60 days; your renewal date stays the same.
  • Cancelling: cancel at any time in your customer portal. Cancelling stops your next renewal; it is not a refund request, so deliveries you already paid for still arrive. Refunds follow section 3.
  • Renewals: renewal orders are dispatched two working days after the charge; cancel before dispatch and we refund the renewal in full. After a Year has renewed, you can end it at any time with one month’s notice, and we refund €59 for every duo not yet dispatched.
  • Gifting: send a delivery as a gift to another address in the EU from your customer portal. Your membership, Care Credit and guarantee stay with you.
  • Price protection: your member price stays the same for as long as you stay a member, also during a pause, even if our prices rise.
  • Care Credit: members earn 10% (60-Day rhythm) or 20% (Year) of every membership payment as Care Credit, to spend on any order. The full rules are in our Terms and Conditions.

entries.en:
The price you see includes VAT. A “was” price is always our lowest price of the previous 30 days, and every review comes from a verified order.

In accordance with the EU Omnibus Directive (2019/2161) and the Belgian Code of Economic Law (Art. VI.19/1 WER):

  • All-inclusive pricing. Prices shown to European consumers include VAT and all applicable levies. Shipping costs are shown before final checkout.
  • Genuine discounts. When we announce a price reduction, the reference price is the lowest price KARMICARE applied in the preceding 30 days.
  • Authentic reviews. We only collect and publish reviews from verified purchasers. Reviews are never manipulated, selectively hidden or bought.

entries.en: 8. Complaints and dispute resolution
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Write to us first: we reply within 2 working days and give you a solution or a substantiated answer within 7 working days. If we cannot agree, independent help is available.

Email care@karmicare.com, or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, about any issue with an order, a delivery or a formula. We reply within 2 working days and give a solution or substantiated answer within 7 working days. Customer care answers in English and Dutch.

If we cannot reach an amicable solution, you have access to independent out-of-court dispute resolution.

8.1 Belgian Consumer Mediation Service

For Belgian and cross-border European disputes: Consumer Mediation Service (Consumentenombudsdienst / Service de Médiation pour le Consommateur), North Gate II, Boulevard du Roi Albert II 8, box 1, 1000 Brussels, Belgium · Tel. +32 2 702 52 00 · contact@consumentenombudsdienst.be · consumerombudsman.be/en

8.2 European Consumer Centre

For a dispute across EU borders, the European Consumer Centre in your country can help. In Belgium: European Consumer Centre Belgium, Koning Albert II-laan 16, 1000 Brussels · Tel. +32 2 277 99 00 · info@eccbelgium.be · eccbe.eu

The EU Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform closed on 20 July 2025, so it is no longer a route for complaints.

This policy explains what we collect about you, why we need it, who helps us process it, and how you stay in control.

KARMICA BV (“KARMICARE”, “we”, “us” or “our”) respects your fundamental right to privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in full compliance with:

  • The General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”);
  • The Belgian Data Protection Act of 30 July 2018;
  • The Belgian Electronic Communications Act of 13 June 2005, transposing the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC as amended;

This policy explains how we collect, process, store, disclose and safeguard your personal data when you visit our website, order from us, start a plan or contact our customer care.

entries.en:
We collect what we need to deliver your order, run your membership and answer your questions. Oral-health data only for the Dental Check-up Reward, and only with your explicit consent.

Depending on how you interact with KARMICARE, we process the following categories of personal data:

  • Identification and contact data: first name, last name, billing and delivery address, email address, telephone number, and company name or VAT number (for B2B dental partners).
  • Transaction and order data: what you ordered, your membership (Awake and Asleep frequency, interval, delivery cycle), order history, payment reference IDs, carrier, order notes and return or refund records. Full card numbers are processed by our PCI-DSS Level 1 payment providers, Stripe and PayPal, and are never stored on our servers.
  • Account and membership data: customer portal login, delivery schedule preferences, pauses and skipped deliveries, and membership status (active, paused, cancelled), and the name and address of anyone you send a delivery to as a gift.
  • Care Credit data: your Care Credit balance, the credit you earn and spend, and your reward status.
  • Check-up data (Year members, only with your explicit consent): your answers to the starting and follow-up questionnaires about your oral health, and proof of your dental visit (an appointment confirmation or invoice).
  • Communication data: records of your messages by email, contact form or the online withdrawal function (your name, the order reference and your email address), including product questions, after-sales questions and feedback.
  • Marketing and newsletter data: email address, first name, communication preferences, newsletter status, open and click events, and discount or voucher use.
  • Technical, navigation and cookie data: IP address (anonymised where applicable), browser and version, device identifier, operating system, referral source, pages viewed, time per page, language, Day/Night preference and cart token.

Your questionnaire answers about your oral health are health data, a special category of personal data (Article 9 GDPR). We process them only with your explicit consent, only for the Dental Check-up Reward and the follow-up of your oral health, and you can withdraw that consent at any time. We do not process other special categories of personal data, such as racial or ethnic origin, genetic or biometric data. Our formulas are notified EU cosmetics, not medicinal treatments.

entries.en: 6. International data transfers
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
When your data leaves the European Economic Area, it travels under an EU-approved safeguard.

When personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA), in particular to the United States, KARMICARE ensures an adequate level of protection in line with Articles 44–49 GDPR:

  1. Adequacy decisions: transfers to countries the European Commission recognises as adequate, such as Canada for commercial organisations under PIPEDA.
  2. EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF): where US providers (such as Shopify, Google, Meta, Klaviyo, Stripe and Webflow) are certified under the DPF.
  3. Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs): where providers are not DPF-certified, transfers follow the Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses (Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914), with transfer impact assessments and encryption safeguards.

You can ask for a copy of the relevant safeguards at care@karmicare.com.

entries.en: 7. How long we keep your data
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
We keep your data only as long as the purpose or the law requires, then delete or anonymise it.

We store personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose it was collected for, or to meet legal retention duties:

  • Order, invoicing and accounting records: kept for 7 years after the end of the financial year (Art. III.86 WER and Art. 315 CIR92).
  • Membership and Care Credit records: kept while your membership is active, then 7 years after it ends, for tax and limitation purposes.
  • Check-up questionnaires and visit proof: proof of your dental visit is deleted 60 days after we have checked it; we keep only the date it was verified. Your questionnaire answers are kept while your membership continues and for 24 months after it ends, so your oral-health history is still there if you return. If you withdraw your consent, we delete them straight away.
  • Customer care messages: kept for 2 years after resolution, to handle legal guarantee claims and disputes.
  • Newsletter and marketing data: kept until you withdraw consent or unsubscribe. After 24 months of inactivity, your data is removed or archived.
  • Analytics and cookie data: kept for at most 13 months, then deleted or permanently anonymised.

entries.en: Your rights
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en: 8. Your rights under the GDPR
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
You can see, correct, delete, move or limit your data, and object to marketing at any time. We answer within one month.

As a data subject, you have the following rights:

  1. Access (Art. 15): ask whether we process your data and receive a free copy of it.
  2. Rectification (Art. 16): have inaccurate data corrected or incomplete data completed.
  3. Erasure (Art. 17): have your data deleted when it is no longer needed, when you withdraw consent or when processing is unlawful, subject to legal retention duties (for example the Belgian 7-year accounting rules).
  4. Restriction (Art. 18): have processing frozen while the accuracy or lawfulness of the data is contested.
  5. Portability (Art. 20): receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON, CSV) and have it transferred to another provider.
  6. Objection (Art. 21): object at any time, without giving a reason, to direct marketing, and object to processing based on legitimate interests on grounds relating to your situation.
  7. Withdrawing consent (Art. 7(3)): withdraw consent for newsletters, marketing cookies or the check-up questionnaires at any time, without affecting earlier processing.
  8. No automated decisions (Art. 22): KARMICARE does not use automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects for you.

How to exercise your rights

Email care@karmicare.com or write to KARMICA BV — Privacy Operations, Vizierstraat 28, 8000 Bruges, Belgium.

We respond without undue delay and at the latest within one month of receipt. Where necessary, given the complexity and number of requests, this can be extended by two further months; we then tell you within the first month.

Your right to complain

entries.en: 9. Cookies and tracking
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Essential cookies keep the shop working. Everything else waits for your consent where the law requires it, and you can change your mind at any time.

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies (local storage, session tokens, pixel tags) to make the site work, remember your preferences and, with your consent, measure traffic and show relevant advertising.

9.1 Cookie categories

  • Strictly necessary: core operation of the shop, security, sessions, cart and checkout. These need no consent and cannot be switched off (Art. 5(3) ePrivacy Directive exemption).
  • Functional: remember your language (en, nl, fr), country and Day/Night preference.
  • Performance and analytics: measure traffic, referrers and site performance (for example Google Analytics 4, Hotjar). In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland active only after your explicit consent; elsewhere by default (see 9.2).
  • Marketing and advertising: set by advertising partners (for example Meta Pixel, TriplePixel, Klaviyo) to track visits across websites and build interest profiles for targeted ads. In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland active only after your explicit consent; elsewhere by default (see 9.2).

9.2 Your consent choices

On your first visit, our consent banner lets you accept all cookies, decline all non-essential cookies, or choose by category.

In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, no non-essential cookies or tracking scripts run before you opt in. Elsewhere, analytics and advertising technologies may run by default. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time through the “Cookie preferences” link in our footer. If you withdraw analytics consent while Hotjar is running, the analytics cookies Hotjar set on our site are deleted immediately, and the page refreshes within a few seconds to stop recording.

entries.en: 10. Data security
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Your data travels encrypted, and only the people who need it can reach it.

KARMICA BV uses technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against accidental loss, unauthorised access, destruction, misuse or alteration:

  • TLS encryption for all web traffic and data transfers;
  • role-based access controls and multi-factor authentication (MFA) for administrative systems;
  • anonymisation and pseudonymisation of analytics data;
  • regular system audits, automatic security patching and vulnerability management;
  • data processing agreements with every sub-processor, requiring confidentiality and GDPR compliance.

entries.en: Clause 4 – Withdrawal, money-back guarantees and refunds
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Every first order comes with a money-back guarantee: 14 days on Try Once, your first cycle on the 60-Day rhythm, 60 days on the Year. Your legal right to withdraw comes on top.

4.1 Statutory right of withdrawal (14 days)

  1. 14-day withdrawal period: you may withdraw from a contract concluded online without giving a reason within 14 calendar days of physical delivery (Article VI.47 WER). For a membership, the period runs from your first delivery. Tell us before the period ends: through the online withdrawal function (Withdraw from contract here), by email at care@karmicare.com, by phone on +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, or with the model form in the Annex (Article VI.49 WER). Any clear statement is enough; you do not need our approval.
  2. Reimbursement: we reimburse all payments received from you, including the standard delivery charge, without undue delay and at the latest within 14 calendar days of the day we are informed of your withdrawal (Article VI.50 §1 WER). We may withhold the reimbursement until we have received the goods back or until you have supplied proof that you sent them, whichever comes first (Article VI.50 §3 WER).
  3. Same payment method: we reimburse via the same payment method you used, at no cost to you. We never substitute a voucher unless you expressly ask for one.
  4. Returning the goods: send the goods back without undue delay and at the latest 14 days after the day you told us; the address and the cost are in clause 4.7 (Article VI.51 §1 WER). For a membership, the goods are everything delivered under it, the Welcome Kit included. You may handle the goods as you would in a shop, to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning. You are liable only for any diminished value that results from handling beyond that (Article VI.51 §2 WER); clause 4.6 explains what this means for a primed pump.
  5. Relation to our guarantees: the money-back guarantees in clauses 4.2 to 4.5 are voluntary commercial guarantees. They come on top of your statutory rights and never limit them.

4.2 Try Once: 14-day money-back guarantee

  1. Period: 14 calendar days from delivery.
  2. Opened formulas qualify: you may open and try the duo and keep it. No return is required.
  3. Refund: everything you paid for the order, including the shipping charge, within 14 days of your request, to your original payment method.

4.3 60-Day rhythm: money-back guarantee for your first cycle

  1. Scope: the guarantee applies to new members and covers the first 60-day cycle only.
  2. Deadline: your request must reach us before your first renewal is charged (60 days after your order). We remind you at least 5 days before. Continuing into the second cycle ends the guarantee.
  3. Refund: your first membership payment, minus the Care Credit earned from that payment that you already used on another order, unless you return the articles you bought with it (clause 4.7.6). Unused Care Credit earned from that payment lapses. The refund follows within 14 days of your request, to your original payment method.
  4. What you keep: the duo and the Welcome Kit. Nothing has to be returned. Your membership ends and no renewal follows.

4.4 Year: 60-day money-back guarantee

  1. Deadline: within 60 calendar days of your first delivery.
  2. Refund: your annual payment, minus the Care Credit earned from that payment that you already used on another order, unless you return the articles you bought with it (clause 4.7.6). Unused Care Credit earned from that payment lapses, remaining deliveries are cancelled and the renewal is stopped.
  3. Return: you keep the opened duo and the Welcome Kit. The other duos come back unopened (pump never primed) within 14 days of your request, with the prepaid return label we send you at our expense.
  4. Deductions: for each additional duo that comes back opened, or does not come back, €59 is deducted from the refund.
  5. Lost return parcels: we carry the transport risk of our prepaid label. The refund is paid once the carrier’s tracking shows the parcel was handed in.
  6. Timing: the refund follows within 14 days of receiving the returned duos, to your original payment method.

4.5 One money-back guarantee per customer

Each customer is entitled to one money-back guarantee in total, whichever option they start with (Try Once, 60-Day rhythm or Year). Switching plans or rejoining does not create a new guarantee. This rule never limits your statutory withdrawal right or your legal guarantee of conformity.

4.6 Packaging notice: airless pump and first-use priming

  1. Hermetic airless packaging: where KARMICARE formulas come in airless packaging, the pump creates a continuous vacuum that protects the active formulation from air, oxidation and bacterial contamination without harsh chemical preservatives.
  2. Unprimed factory state and priming: the pumps are not pre-pumped. On first use, press the pump head firmly 3 to 10 times to draw the formula into the nozzle.
  3. Primed pumps and your right of withdrawal: priming the pump and using a formula goes beyond what is needed to establish its nature, characteristics and functioning. Your statutory right of withdrawal remains. If you withdraw after priming or using a formula, we may deduct the resulting loss of value from your refund, up to the full price of that formula (Article VI.51 §2 WER). An unprimed pump and the packaging can be checked freely. Our money-back guarantees in clauses 4.2 to 4.4 are more generous and are not affected.

4.7 How to request a refund or return

  1. Email care@karmicare.com, or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, with your order number and the option you chose (Try Once, 60-Day rhythm or Year).
  2. For a statutory withdrawal, send the goods back within 14 days of telling us to: KARMICA BV, Returns Department, Vizierstraat 28, 8000 Bruges, Belgium. You need no return authorisation; we acknowledge your withdrawal by email and confirm the address. You pay the direct cost of return shipping, unless the return is due to a defect or our shipping error.
  3. We never charge administrative fees on a refund. On a statutory withdrawal, the only possible deduction is for diminished value under clause 4.6 (Article VI.51 §2 WER); on a refund under the legal guarantee of conformity there is none. A Care Credit amount is set off against a statutory refund only with your express agreement under clause 4.7.5. Under our voluntary guarantees and the renewal refunds, the deductions are those set out in clauses 4.3, 4.4, 9.9 and 4.7.6.
  4. Care Credit and refunds: if you paid part of an order with Care Credit, the money you paid goes back to your original payment method and the Care Credit you used returns to your balance. Care Credit earned on an amount that is refunded lapses from your balance in proportion to that amount (a partial refund cancels only the credit earned on the part refunded), because the payment it rewarded no longer exists; nothing is deducted for lapsed credit you had not used, and we never recover unused credit in cash. If you had already used part of that credit to pay for articles on another order, we identify that order, the articles concerned and the Care Credit attributable to the amount being refunded before asking for your choice. You may return those articles with the prepaid label we send you, within 14 days of receiving it: no Care Credit is deducted for the articles returned, we refund the money you paid for them, and any set-off already applied for them is reversed. If you return some of the articles, only the credit attributable to the articles you keep can be counted. The same credit is never counted twice, and no amount ever exceeds the credit attributable to the articles you keep. What applies when you keep the articles depends on the refund route: clause 4.7.5 for your statutory rights, clause 4.7.6 for our voluntary guarantees and renewal refunds. Care Credit is never paid out in cash.
  5. Care Credit on a statutory withdrawal or a legal-guarantee refund: your statutory refund (clauses 4.1 and 7) is paid in full and within the legal period whatever you decide about the articles. Any arrangement to keep the articles and pay the Care Credit attributable to them must be lawful and expressly agreed by you after we have given you the information in clause 4.7.4. We do not treat silence as agreement, and we do not delay or reduce the refund required by your statutory rights while seeking that agreement; if you do not choose, we refund in full and ask you again about the articles. Any agreed set-off is limited to an enforceable amount for the articles you keep and never recovers the same credit twice (Articles VI.50 §1 and VI.51 §5 WER; Articles 1649quinquies and 1649octies of the old Civil Code; Articles 5.254, 5.255 and 5.263 of the Civil Code).
  6. Care Credit under our voluntary guarantees and renewal refunds: under the money-back guarantees in clauses 4.3 and 4.4 and the renewal refunds in clause 9.9, you choose, after we have given you the information in clause 4.7.4, between returning the articles you bought with the credit attributable to the refunded amount (nothing is deducted for them) and keeping them, in which case that credit is deducted from the refund, as those clauses say. If you do not choose, we deduct it; if you still return the articles within the period in clause 4.7.4, we reverse the deduction. The deduction never exceeds the credit attributable to the articles you keep.

entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Prices include VAT, your member price is protected while you stay, and memberships ship free.

  1. Prices: prices are shown on our website and at checkout. For deliveries within the European Union, they include Belgian VAT or the VAT rate of your EU country through the EU One-Stop Shop (OSS).
  2. Member price protection: the price of your membership stays the same for as long as your membership continues, including during a pause. When your membership ends, a later membership starts at the price applicable at that time.
  3. Personal offers: we may make you a personal offer, such as a member price, by email or in your account. The offer states its price and conditions; these Terms apply to everything else, including price protection.
  4. Shipping charges: memberships ship free within the European Union. For Try Once, the shipping charge for your delivery zone is shown at checkout before payment.
  5. Price reductions (Omnibus Directive): under Article VI.19/1 WER, when we advertise a price reduction, the reference price is the lowest price KARMICARE applied for that product in the 30 calendar days before the promotion.

  1. Accepted methods: Bancontact / Payconiq, iDEAL, credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Maestro), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay and PayPal.

entries.en: Clause 7 – Legal guarantee of conformity
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
A faulty pump, a defective formula or a broken brush is covered for two years. Using up a formula is not a defect.

  1. Legal framework: as a consumer you have a legal guarantee of conformity under Articles 1649bis to 1649octies of the Belgian (old) Civil Code, as replaced by the Law of 20 March 2022 transposing Directive (EU) 2019/771. Nothing in this clause limits that guarantee; any term that did would be void (Article 1649octies).
  2. What conformity means: the goods must match our description, be fit for the purposes goods of that type are normally used for, and have the quality and durability that is normal for such goods and that you can reasonably expect, including on the basis of our advertising and labelling (Article 1649ter). Awake and Asleep are consumable cosmetic goods designed to be used up over a cycle of daily use (for example 30 to 60 days, depending on volume and frequency). The guarantee does not mean a formula lasts two years once opened. Normal depletion, natural bristle wear, and use beyond the Period After Opening (PAO) or the minimum durability date are not a lack of conformity.
  3. Two years, presumed from delivery: we are liable for any lack of conformity that exists at delivery and becomes apparent within two years of delivery (Article 1649quater §1). A lack of conformity that appears within those two years is presumed to have existed at delivery, unless we prove otherwise or that is incompatible with the nature of the goods or of the defect (Article 1649quater §4). It is not up to you to prove the cause.
  4. Your remedies: you choose between a free repair and a free replacement, unless the remedy you choose is impossible or would impose disproportionate costs on us compared with the other (Article 1649quinquies §§1 and 2). If we do not repair or replace within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to you, if we refuse, if the defect persists, or if it is serious enough, you are entitled to a proportionate price reduction or to end the contract and be refunded (Article 1649quinquies §5). Ending the contract is not possible for a minor defect, and it is up to us to prove that a defect is minor.
  5. Notification: tell us within two months of discovering a lack of conformity (Article 1649quater §2) by emailing care@karmicare.com with your order number, a description, and photos or a video of the defect. We handle every claim free of charge.
  6. Not a lack of conformity: normal depletion of a formula; natural wear of toothbrush bristles; damage caused after delivery by improper storage (extreme temperatures, direct sunlight, moisture or tampering with the pump); use after the PAO or the expiry date, although a lack of conformity that appeared before that date stays covered.

The examples below illustrate the guarantee. They never limit your legal rights.

Examples

  2. Consumable oral care (nature of the goods): under Article 1649quater, §4 of the Belgian Civil Code, the guarantee applies taking into account the nature of the goods.   3. What is covered: latent manufacturing defects and mechanical non-conformities present at or arising from delivery: failure, jamming or breakage of the airless pump while formula remains inside under normal use; formulation defects such as premature separation, contamination, abnormal discolouration or instability before the expiry date or PAO when stored as recommended; defective seals, leaking containers or structural defects in toothbrush handles or floss dispensers.
  4. Remedies: for a verified manufacturing or packaging defect, KARMICARE provides a free replacement of the defective unit (or a replacement bottle or pump). If replacement is impossible or disproportionate, you are entitled to a proportionate price reduction, or to end the contract with a full refund.

Examples

entries.en:
Normal product depletion: excluded Example: asking for a replacement because the formula has been used up.
Why: consumable cosmetics are designed to be used up; normal exhaustion fulfils the contract.

Normal bristle wear: excluded Example: bristles splaying or softening after 2–3 months of daily brushing.
Why: routine wear and tear; dentists recommend replacing a toothbrush every 2–3 months.

Expired Period After Opening (PAO): excluded Example: a bottle opened 18 months ago dries out.
Why: stability is certified only within the indicated PAO.

Improper storage: excluded Example: a bottle left on a radiator or in a hot car separates.
Why: heat damage caused by storage against the storage guidelines.

Airless pump failure: covered Example: the piston jams or the head breaks in week 2 under normal use while formula remains inside.
Remedy: free replacement, or repair if you prefer.

Formulation or batch defect: covered Example: curdled, separated or discoloured formula on first use.
Remedy: free replacement or full refund.

Unopened stock within shelf life: covered Example: a properly stored, unopened plan bottle goes bad before its printed expiry date.
Remedy: free replacement.

Structural toothbrush or floss defect: covered Example: a handle snaps on day 4 or bristles shed on first use.
Remedy: free replacement.

entries.en: Clause 8 – Delivery and transfer of risk
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Until your parcel is in your hands, it is our responsibility.

  1. Transfer of risk (Art. VI.44 WER): the risk of loss, theft or damage in transit stays with KARMICA BV until you, or a third party you designate (other than the carrier), take physical possession.
  2. Delivery area: we deliver to addresses in the member states of the European Union. Please make sure your shipping address is complete and correct.
  3. Delivery times (estimates): Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg: within 24 hours; rest of the European Union: 2–3 working days.
  4. Delays: unless another date was agreed, we deliver within 30 days of the contract. If we do not, you can ask for delivery within an additional reasonable period. If we still fail to deliver, you can end the contract and receive a full refund of everything you paid within 14 calendar days of termination.

entries.en: Clause 9 – Memberships
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
No lock-in, a protected price and a reminder before every renewal. Gift, pause, skip or stop whenever you like.

  1. The options: Try Once is a single duo without renewal. The 60-Day rhythm delivers one duo and renews every 60 days. The Year delivers six duos, three at the start and three six months later, and renews once a year on its anniversary; a Year that starts on 29 February renews on 28 February. Prices are shown at checkout.
  2. Authorisation: when you start a membership, you authorise KARMICARE (through our payment processor, Stripe) to charge your chosen payment method automatically at each renewal: every 60 days, or once a year.
  3. Welcome Kit: your first membership order includes a Welcome Kit with a morning toothbrush, an evening toothbrush and a charcoal floss.
  4. Renewal reminder: we email you at least 5 days before every 60-Day rhythm renewal, and 30 days and 7 days before every Year renewal, so you can pause, reschedule, skip or cancel in time.
  5. Pausing: you can pause for up to 60 days at a time, and for up to 60 days in total within any 12 months. On the Year, a pause postpones your second delivery by up to 60 days; your renewal date stays the same.
  6. Cancelling: you can cancel at any time in your customer portal or by email. Cancelling stops your next renewal; it is not a refund request. Deliveries you already paid for, such as the second half of a Year, still arrive. Refunds follow clause 4; for a renewed membership, see 9.9.
  7. End of your membership: your membership ends when the last period you paid for runs out.
  8. Switching plans: to move from the 60-Day rhythm to the Year, cancel your 60-Day rhythm and start a Year membership. A switch does not create a new money-back guarantee (clause 4.5).
  9. Renewal orders and ending a renewed Year: renewal orders are dispatched two working days after the charge. If you cancel before dispatch, we refund the renewal in full. After a Year has renewed, you can end it at any time with one month’s notice; we refund €59 for every duo not yet dispatched. Care Credit earned on the refunded amount lapses; if you had already used it to pay for articles on another order, you may return those articles instead of having that credit deducted (clause 4.7.6).
  10. Gifting: you can send a delivery as a gift to another address in the European Union from your customer portal. The membership, its payments, Care Credit, the right of withdrawal and the money-back guarantee stay with you; the recipient receives the formulas only.

entries.en: Clause 10 – Care Credit
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Members earn Care Credit with every payment and can spend it on any order. It stays valid while you are a member, and for 12 months after.

  1. Earning: you earn Care Credit worth 10% of each 60-Day rhythm payment and 20% of each Year payment. It is available immediately after a successful payment.
  2. Other Care Credit: Year members can earn the Dental Check-up Reward as Care Credit (clause 11), and you receive €5 for completing the starting questionnaire.
  3. Spending: you can apply Care Credit to any product, including membership orders. It is deducted from that order only; it does not change your membership price or later charges.
  4. No cash value: Care Credit is never paid out in cash and cannot be transferred.
  5. Validity: Care Credit stays valid while your membership continues and for 12 months after it ends (clause 9.7). If you rejoin within those 12 months, your remaining credit carries over.
  6. Refunds: if an order is refunded, the Care Credit you used on it returns to your balance and the Care Credit earned on the refunded amount lapses in proportion; nothing is deducted for credit you had not used. If you had already used that credit on articles of another order, we tell you which order, which articles and which amount before you choose: return those articles (nothing deducted, your money for them refunded) or keep them. On a statutory withdrawal or a legal-guarantee refund, keeping them and paying the credit needs your express agreement and never delays or reduces your statutory refund; under our voluntary guarantees and renewal refunds, that credit is deducted. Clauses 4.7.4 to 4.7.6 have the full rule.

entries.en: Clause 12 – Force majeure
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
If something truly beyond anyone’s control blocks the contract for more than 30 days, either of us can end it and you get your money back.

  1. Neither party is liable for delay or failure caused by force majeure (Article 5.226 of the Belgian Civil Code): an event beyond reasonable control that is unforeseeable, unavoidable and makes performance temporarily or permanently impossible (for example natural disasters, armed conflict, government restrictions, severe disruption of telecom or power networks, pandemic travel bans or general postal strikes).
  2. During force majeure, our obligations are suspended. If it lasts more than 30 consecutive days, either party may end the contract with immediate effect by written notice, and all prepaid amounts for undelivered goods are refunded within 14 calendar days without further compensation.

entries.en:
Every review comes from a verified order, and the site is for lawful use only.

  1. Review authenticity: reviews published on karmicare.com are collected only from verified purchasers, through automated verification after delivery. We do not publish incentivised, fake or sponsored reviews presented as organic feedback.
  2. Acceptable use: you agree to use our website and customer portal only for lawful purposes and in line with these Terms. Automated scraping, data harvesting, malicious code or interference with checkout is prohibited.

entries.en: Clause 15 – Complaints, applicable law and courts
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Write to us first. If we cannot agree, independent mediation is available, and the consumer law of your own country still protects you.

  1. Complaints: for questions, feedback or complaints, write to our customer care at care@karmicare.com or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61. We reply within 2 working days and give a substantiated answer or solution within 7 working days. Customer care answers in English and Dutch.
  2. Out-of-court dispute resolution: if we cannot reach an amicable solution, European consumers can turn to independent consumer mediation: the Belgian Consumer Mediation Service (Consumentenombudsdienst / Service de Médiation pour le Consommateur), North Gate II, Boulevard du Roi Albert II 8, box 1, 1000 Brussels · Tel. +32 2 702 52 00 · contact@consumentenombudsdienst.be · consumerombudsman.be/en. For a dispute across EU borders, the European Consumer Centre in your country can help; in Belgium: European Consumer Centre Belgium, Koning Albert II-laan 16, 1000 Brussels · Tel. +32 2 277 99 00 · info@eccbelgium.be.
  3. Applicable law: all agreements between KARMICA BV and its customers are governed by Belgian law. Under Article 6 of Regulation (EC) No 593/2008 (“Rome I”), this choice does not deprive a consumer living in another EU member state of the protection of the mandatory provisions of the law of their country of habitual residence.
  4. Competent courts: for consumers domiciled in the European Union, the jurisdiction rules of the Brussels I bis Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012 apply: you may bring proceedings before the Belgian courts or the competent courts of the member state where you live. For B2B purchasers, the Enterprise Court of Ghent, division Bruges, has exclusive jurisdiction.

The EU Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform closed on 20 July 2025, so it is no longer a route for complaints.

entries.en: You have the right to access your Personal Data and the ways in which we use them at any time, free of charge. You have the right to request us to correct, supplement or remove your Personal Data. In a number of cases listed in the GDPR, you may also ask us to limit the processing of your Personal Data. You have the right to object to the processing of your Personal Data if you have serious and legitimate reasons that exceed our need to process your data. You also have the right to object at any time to the use of Personal Data for direct marketing purposes, even without having to give a reason. You have the right to request your Personal Data in digital and readable form and/or to have them transferred to another service provider of your choice. Insofar as our processing is based on your prior consent, you have the right to revoke that consent at any time.

entries.en: Sealed delivery and opened formulas: Awake and Asleep are delivered sealed. The pump is unprimed and the nozzle holds no formula; priming the pump breaks that seal. Once primed, a formula can no longer be sold for hygiene reasons, so the statutory right of withdrawal no longer applies to it (Art. VI.53, 5° WER). Should that exception not apply in your case, we may deduct the loss of value caused by the use from your refund, up to the full price of the formula (Art. VI.51 §2 WER). Our money-back guarantees in clauses 4.2 to 4.4 are more generous and are not affected.

entries.en: Consumable oral care (nature of the goods): under Article 1649quater, §4 of the Belgian Civil Code, the guarantee applies taking into account the nature of the goods. KARMICARE formulas are consumable cosmetic goods designed for an intended cycle of daily use (for example 30 to 60 days, depending on volume and frequency). The guarantee does not mean a formula lasts two years once opened. Normal depletion, natural bristle wear, or use beyond the Period After Opening (PAO) or minimum durability date is not a lack of conformity.

entries.en: The options: Try Once is a single duo without renewal. The 60-Day rhythm delivers one duo and renews every 60 days. The Year delivers six duos, three at the start and three six months later, and renews once a year on its anniversary; a Year that starts on 29 February renews on 28 February. Prices are shown at checkout.

entries.en: Pausing: you can pause for up to 60 days at a time, and for up to 60 days in total within any 12 months. On the Year, a pause postpones your second delivery by up to 60 days; your renewal date stays the same.

entries.en: Cancelling: you can cancel at any time in your customer portal or by email. Cancelling stops your next renewal; it is not a refund request. Deliveries you already paid for, such as the second half of a Year, still arrive. Refunds follow clause 4; for a renewed membership, see 9.9.

entries.en: Renewal orders and ending a renewed Year: renewal orders are dispatched two working days after the charge. If you cancel before dispatch, we refund the renewal in full. After a Year has renewed, you can end it at any time with one month’s notice; we refund €59 for every duo not yet dispatched. Care Credit earned on a refunded amount is removed, or deducted if you already spent it (clause 4.7).

“There’s no fluoride in our Awake or Asleep toothpaste. Nor will there ever be.”
— Victor Popov, Founder of Karmicare

entries.en: WHY? Because as well as resisting negative self-talk, I avoid putting chemicals into my system. Especially chemicals that prevent natural healing and spiritual growth. And especially when there are far more powerful ingredients available.Ingredients such as hydroxyapatite. I know, I can hear you thinking hydroxy-what? You may not have heard of it but it makes up 97% of your tooth enamel. Its “nano” form (as first discovered by NASA) can fuse with your enamel, replace lost minerals, whiten teeth, reduce sensitivity and much, much more. In short, it could be the answer to your dental health problems. Want your teeth to constantly feel stronger, healthier, smoother, and resistant to the sudden jolt/pain of hot and cold drinks? Swap fluoride for nano HAp. I’ve experienced these benefits myself, which is why I call it the “wonder-mineral” and that’s why it’s one of the stars of Karmicare’s biorhythmic formulated toothpaste.

entries.en: So, What Is Nano Hydroxyapatite?

entries.en:
“Hydroxy-WHAT?!” — we get it.
It’s a bit of a mouthful to speak and to spell.
But while it may seem strange to you, your body is highly familiar with this magic mineral.
Hydroxyapatite (HA) is a naturally occurring form of calcium phosphate (so no need for the synthesis of ingredients in a lab) that makes up 97% of your tooth enamel, 70% of dentin, and up to 70% of bone mass. It’s also found in your saliva. And because it’s a natural substance, hydroxyapatite is often used in biomimetic dentistry, which aims to protect the integrity of your teeth. The primary purpose of HA is to give bones and teeth their rigidity.
Nano hydroxyapatite (nano HAp) is an altered version of HA that has the natural ability to fuse with the existing hydroxyapatite in teeth.

entries.en: Oral health is an integral component of physical wellness. The oral cavity is not an isolated organ but a vital part of the rest of the body. Experts link oral hygiene to systemic, long term diseases.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 35 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)

entries.en: For instance, The American Heart Association reports that gum disease is a significant risk factor for cardiovascular diseases.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 36 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)

entries.en: Bacteria from gum infections can penetrate the bloodstream and induce inflammation of the blood vessels. This results in arterial plaque - a buildup of substances like fats, cholesterol, and calcium in and on the artery walls.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 37 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)

entries.en: Plaque can also obstruct blood flow. This increases the risk of heart attack and stroke.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 38 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Arterial plaque raising the risk of heart attack and stroke, the end of the chain in b036/b037 (needs-review) (R6, review R6-01); was 'none'.

entries.en: Gum infection is also linked to diabetes.

entries.en: Common Causes of Tooth Pain
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 4 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en:
Cavities:
Cavities are a major cause of tooth pain. Bacteria break down sugar into acid, eroding the enamel and exposing dentin, which leads to sensitivity and pain. If left untreated, decay can reach the pulp, causing severe pain and infection.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 5 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en:
Gum Infection:
Gingivitis and periodontitis cause tooth pain by inflaming gums, due to plaque buildup. Without treatment, infection spreads to the deeper structures that support the teeth. This can result in loose teeth and pain from the gums to the teeth.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 6 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en:
Tooth Sensitivity:
Enamel wear or gum recession exposes the dentin. This causes a painful sensation from hot, cold, or sweet foods. Switching to a softer toothbrush and using toothpaste designed for sensitive teeth can help.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 7 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: approved (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: General advice at cosmetic scope; Do say 'Reduces sensitivity'.

entries.en:
Cracked or Damaged Teeth:
Trauma, grinding, or biting down on hard objects can crack or damage teeth. These cracks can expose the inner layers of the tooth, leading to pain and sensitivity.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 8 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en:
Dental Abscesses:
Abscesses are bacterial infections that form painful pus pockets. They often lead to throbbing pain and swelling that requires urgent care.

entries.en:
Tension Headaches:
This is the most common type of headache. It feels like a dull, tight band around the forehead. Tension headaches are often triggered by stress, poor posture, or neck and shoulder tension.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 22 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en:
Migraines:
Intense, throbbing pain, usually on one side, lasting hours or days. They often come with vomiting, nausea, and light/sound sensitivity. Jaw-related issues might trigger migraines.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 23 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Jaw issues as a migraine trigger; medical association in brand copy.

entries.en:
Sinus Headaches:
These are caused by inflamed sinuses from infection or allergies. These lead to facial pressure and pain and are often mistaken for tension headaches. Dental problems in the upper teeth may worsen sinus headaches.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 24 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Dental problems worsening sinus headaches; medical association in brand copy.

entries.en:
Cluster Headaches:
This is a rare but severe headache that occurs in cycles, often waking people from sleep. It is characterized by intense pain around one eye or one side of the head. It is not directly linked to dental issues but is worsened by stress and poor sleep.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 25 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en: Tooth pain and headaches are often linked through referred pain. This occurs when pain from one part of the body is felt in another area. The trigeminal nerve, which provides sensation to both the face and mouth, plays a role in this connection.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 28 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Referred-pain mechanism; medical statement in brand copy.

entries.en: Referred pain can make it challenging to pinpoint the exact source of discomfort. This is because the nerves in your face and mouth are closely connected to those in your head. Irritation in one area can trigger pain in another.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 29 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en:
Cavities and Headaches:
Untreated cavities can irritate the tooth’s pulp and lead to headaches. The pain can spread to the head, causing tension headaches or migraines.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 33 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Cavities causing headaches and migraines; medical causal statement.

entries.en:
Wisdom Teeth and Headaches:
As wisdom teeth erupt, they can press on surrounding teeth, blood vessels, nerves, and jaw structures. This pressure can cause tooth pain and headaches, especially if the teeth are impacted.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 34 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Wisdom teeth causing headaches; medical causal statement.

entries.en:
Nerve Sensitivity:
Infections, like abscesses, can spread to the sinuses. The resulting inflammation and pressure can trigger significant headaches, particularly sinus headaches.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 35 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Dental infection spreading to sinuses; medical causal statement.

entries.en:
Exposed Nerves:
Exposed nerves from tooth decay, cracks, or trauma can send pain signals that spread to the head. The result is sharp, stabbing headaches that may be mistaken for migraines.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 36 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order); claim: needs-review (CLAIMS-REVIEW.md, batches 05-07)
entries.claim_basis: Exposed nerves causing headaches; medical causal statement.

entries.en:
Bruxism (Teeth Grinding):
Bruxism, or teeth grinding, is a common dental issue during sleep. The constant grinding and clenching can cause muscle tension in the jaw, leading to tooth pain and tension headaches. Over time, bruxism can lead to sensitivity and cracks.

entries.en: If you’ve spent time reading the ingredient lists on your personal care products, there’s a good chance you’ve seen sodium lauryl sulfate (or SLS) somewhere in the formula. entries.en: In a nutshell, sodium lauryl sulfate is a surfactant that acts as an emulsifier.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 18 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en: Think of it this way: When a product contains oil and water, the only way to get those ingredients to blend is to add an element that helps them do exactly that. Even though other ingredients do this (more on that soon), SLS often pops up on those ingredient lists.
entries.notes: captured 2026-10-19 20:15 CEST (karmicares.myshopify.com, live theme = 3bae259); block 19 of the rendered body_html, in document order (join the blocks back in order)

entries.en: It’s not just about SLS acting as a thickener, however; it’s also about it being used as a foaming agent.

entries.en: Many times, it’s sodium lauryl sulfate that’s responsible for the foamy shampoo experience you get when you wash your hair or dishes.
